records.title: Pigeon-transfer instructions with literal destination and reference fields
records.header_literal: A) OSM v LP (02.00 p.m., September 20th); 1250 (19.9) FUER USK - UND - 1809 2 TLE; RICHI-222
records.readable_german: AKONACH 22. Zu dort ROEM3 Nr. 8S86: Versandziel ANI nachdrahten. Die 150 ausgesuchte Tauben ueberweisen WIRD. Nachr. Chef RM4D84760.
records.meaning: The record concerns a telegraphed dispatch destination and the transfer of pigeons. Its literal 150, ANI, ROEM3, 8S86 and final WIRD remain uninterpreted where the syntax or reference is uncertain; no omitted letter or historical number is silently supplied.
notes: The printed invalid symbols W and T in AWTDF are retained literally and masked independently for decoding. Their proposed V and F values complete AKONACH and CHEF at two source-mask fills, with no observed-coordinate substitution.
ROEM3, 8S86, ANI, 150, WIRD and RM4D84760 remain exactly as decoded; their presence does not prove a historical numeral or repair the awkward pigeon-transfer syntax.
The header advertises 2 TLE but only one section-A ciphertext body is printed on this page. No absent second body is invented or counted.

records.title: Army Group East to receive its own German AKONACH
records.header_literal: B) OSM v LP (02.02 p.m., September 20th); 1800 (19.9) FUER OSM 2 TLE; 1 TL; RICHI-168
records.readable_german: AKONACH 70. Zu RM1 Nr. 22750 V. 6.9.18. Hgr. Ost wird demnaechst eigenen deutschen AKONACH erhalten.
records.meaning: Reports that Army Group East will shortly receive its own German AKONACH. The raw reference fields and abbreviation remain literal.
notes: The second glyph in group 4, ACXXV, is C-like and is retained as invalid C/masked. A faint or defective G cannot be ruled out, so the complete AGXXV source variant is retained separately. The word AKONACH does not determine the source glyph.

Under the conservative C-like transcription, choosing G costs one source-mask fill. The distinct F-to-A change at source index164 repairs 6EMNAECHST to DEMNAECHST at one observed-coordinate substitution.
The closing AKONACH is unedited and supplies an internal vocabulary witness for the damaged opening.

records.title: Reorganization of the subordination relationship of Funk A151
records.header_literal: B) OSM v LP (02.02 p.m., September 20th); 1800 (19.9) FUER OSM 2 TLE; 2 TL; RICHI-152
records.readable_german: Hierauf Neuregelung des Unterstellungsverhaeltnisses Funk A151. Nachr. Chef 1B16020.
records.meaning: The second printed part announces a resulting reorganization of the radio unit or service named by the literal Funk A151 label. The certificate does not turn that label into a separately identified historical formation.
notes: The entire152-slot body decodes without any mask, substitution, insertion, deletion or reordering.
This is the explicitly printed second part of sectionB; the literal A151 and1B16020 fields remain unassigned.

prior_credit: Historical Sep19-21 key: Childs, printed p236; published key and cryptanalytic work: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Source transcription, edition and explicit repair accounting: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. This source edition makes no universal first-decipherment claim.
limits: All native source slots remain in printed order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Unknown square cells remain globally coupled and injective. Roundtrip completion witnesses are explicitly nonhistorical.
Observed-coordinate substitutions and source-mask fills are priced separately. A source-compatible word proposal is not proof of unique historical wording.

index_omission.finding: The frozen OCR retrieval pool begins at p57 and has no p56 block. These three physical bodies were found by inspecting the preceding source page, not by counting OCR blocks as complete messages.
